head: eniwher3 is a free online scratch pad for notes and to-dos
dek: eniwher3 is a new free scratch pad that runs in any browser: double-click empty space or paste to drop a note, then drag it anywhere on the board. Sign in with your email and the board syncs between your laptop and phone.
details: Widgets add a to-do list, calendar, clock, stopwatch and code pad, and you can tuck them into a dock. The cream theme turns dark when your device is set to dark mode, with options for high contrast, a plainer font and larger text. The free plan has one board; Premium costs $5 a month and adds more boards, themes and a calculator, and a lifetime plan is $39 once. It went on BetaList on 15 November.
where: Any web browser, free; Premium $5 a month
means: If you jot things on sticky notes or random text files, this keeps them on one board you can open on any device.
todo: You can try it in one browser without an account; sign in only if you want it on your phone too.
thumb_words: FREE NOTE BOARD FOR ANY BROWSER
